headline: Satya Nadella says all AI models are ‘compromised’
summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella urges treating all AI models as potentially compromised. He emphasizes moving away from accepting AI advice unquestioningly. Nadella shared his views on confronting advanced AI risks on X.

headline: DistroKid Quietly Removes Songs Amid UMG 'AI-Slop' Lawsuit
summary: DistroKid is removing artists' songs without notice, sparking widespread complaints. The takedowns are a direct response to a UMG lawsuit against DistroKid. UMG accuses DistroKid of creating an "AI-slop pipeline" for music.

headline: Ledger Wallets Linked to Crypto Thefts, Tampering Suspected
summary: Ledger crypto wallet users report accounts being drained due to suspected tampering. The issue appears linked to hardware sold by reseller CryptoBillis. Ledger has asked CryptoBillis to halt sales and is investigating the thefts.

headline: K-pop Star Sunmi Shares Love for Notion and Ear Cleaning Videos
summary: K-pop icon Sunmi, formerly of Wonder Girls, discusses her personal interests. She reveals a fondness for productivity app Notion and unique ear cleaning videos. Sunmi was part of one of K-pop's first acts to break into the Western market.

headline: New Naruto 'Shadow Rising' Manga and Anime Crossover Announced
summary: Author Masashi Kishimoto announces a new Naruto manga titled "Shadow Rising." A new Naruto anime crossover series is also officially on its way. These teasers confirm the enduring vitality of the Naruto franchise.

headline: Blade Runner 2099 Trailer Features Schafer, Yeoh, and Replicant Mystery
summary: Prime Video released a new trailer for "Blade Runner 2099." The trailer hints at a mystery involving missing Replicants. Hunter Schafer and Michelle Yeoh are featured in the upcoming series.

headline: Arc Raiders 2.0 Update, 'Spider-Man' Grappling Hook Boost Player Count
summary: Arc Raiders' player count hit a seven-month high following its 2.0 update. The update introduced a "Spider-Man" grappling hook and a new map. A free weekend also contributed to the surge in concurrent players.

headline: Paper Girls Creators Reunite for New Image Comics Series 'Roam'
summary: "Paper Girls" creators Brian K. Vaughan and Cliff Chiang are reuniting. They will collaborate on a new Image Comics series titled "Roam." This exclusive announcement came out of NYCC.

headline: Trump Calls for New Ukraine President After Zelensky Condemns Diesel Deal
summary: Donald Trump suggests Ukraine needs a new president. His comments follow Zelensky's condemnation of a US-Russia diesel deal. Zelensky argued the deal would help Russia fund its war efforts.

headline: Man Dies After Entering Tiger Enclosure at Wildlife Park
summary: A man tragically died following a tiger attack at a wildlife park. Police reported the man had entered the tiger enclosure. Details surrounding how he entered the enclosure are under investigation.

headline: Justice Dept. Probes TV Networks Over Trump Pool Coverage Access
summary: The US Justice Department is investigating TV networks' Trump pool coverage. CNN, MS Now, and Politico were blocked access by the White House. This blockage led the networks to restrict pool coverage in response.

headline: MPs Seek to End Police Immunity from Lawsuits for Failings
summary: MPs are working to overturn a ruling granting police immunity from lawsuits. The ruling currently prevents legal action for police failings. MPs aim to allow suits when police fabricate evidence, are dishonest, or negligent.
